propositions: Structured-output validation and retry must execute through a single Pydantic Agent operation with shared request budget instead of split between bespoke orchestration and Pydantic AI.
Retry context must preserve complete failed responses and never truncate authoritative input, accepted output, or stored history.
Rebar must preserve deterministic extraction, fallback eligibility, terminal refusal behavior, and failure artifacts while Pydantic AI handles retries and instrumentation.
Successful operations must report complete Pydantic run usage exactly once; fallback candidates remain trace events rather than competing usage counters.
The bespoke structured-output retry loop must be removed only after compatibility suite and Anthropic/Bedrock cache canaries pass with live parity evidence.
